newsitem.title: USA: Hudson buys 12 properties from Salomon.
newsitem.headline: Hudson buys 12 properties from Salomon.

text.p: Hudson Hotels Corp said it completed the acquisition of 12 limited-service hotel properties from SB Motel Corp, a Salomon Inc unit, for $60.2 million.
Salomon, which will hold about 7.7 percent of Hudson's shares, said in a separate statement it will post a pre-tax gain of $30 million in the fourth quarter from the deal.
Under the deal, Hudson will pay $54.9 million in cash, a $2.9 million note and $2.4 million in Hudson common stock, it said.
Nomura Asset Capital Corp has provided a credit facility of $73 million to finance Hudson Hotels' acquisitions, the company said.
John Buza, a vice president at Salomon Brothers, will represent Salomon Brothers on the hotel's board of directors, effective immediately, the company said.
